dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides point features for sewer-related assets managed by Westbank First Nation (WFN). It supports viewing and using sewer infrastructure locations in GIS applications for asset reference and operational mapping.

Feature Content

  • Sewer points representing individual sewer structures and related assets.
  • Attribute information that supports asset identification, classification, installation history, condition, maintenance context, comments, and related reference details.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation (WFN) IR#9 and IR#10 and reflects sewer infrastructure records maintained for that region.

Use Cases

  • Asset inventory and infrastructure reference
  • Wastewater and sewer network mapping
  • Field operations and maintenance planning
  • Municipal or regional utility record keeping

Access and Licensing

This is owned and maintained by Westbank First Nation (WFN) and is made available under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License, with associated disclaimer and terms of use.
